plain: The share of attack attempts that get the model to produce the harmful behaviour being tested.
eli5: Out of all the times you tried to trick the babysitter, how many times did it work?
technical: The fraction of test cases for which a judge rules that the target's completion exhibits the behaviour; in HarmBench (Mazeika et al. 2024) it is computed with greedy decoding, a fixed 512-token generation length and a fixed classifier, because these settings change ASR by large amounts and made earlier numbers incomparable.
